body_md:
# DBA House Style (DOCX authoring)

Enforcement layer for dissertation drafting. This mirrors `CLAUDE.md` Section 5
and `/memories/repo/drafting-style-rules.md`. `CLAUDE.md` remains the source of
truth; this file exists only to apply the rules automatically when authoring
dissertation content.

## Hard rules

* Never start a sentence with "And" or "Because". Use "Since", "As", or
  restructure the sentence.
* Cross-references to the design chapter read "Chapter 3, Research Design and
  Methodology" or "the Research Design and Methodology chapter". Never write
  "Section 3.x" or a bare "Chapter 3".
* No em dashes (U+2014). No en dashes (U+2013) in prose. En dashes are allowed
  only in numeric ranges and canonical proper-noun compounds (for example a page
  range, or "Job Demands-Resources" in a published title).
* Use "%" rather than "per cent". Use "percentage points" when a figure is the
  gap between two percentages.
* Do not invent compound-modifier hyphens. Keep only those already established
  in the amendment memo or prior drafts (for example quality-adjusted,
  corporate-sponsored, open-source, core-periphery, code-ownership,
  cross-stratum, AI-assisted).
* Keep sentences at or under 30 words. Split long sentences at existing sentence
  boundaries.
* British English throughout. Never mix with American spelling.
* APA 7 in-text citations. Parenthetical uses "&"; prose uses "and".
* Cite or be silent. No hallucinated references. Label unverified items `[VERIFY]`.

## Register

* Write for a multidisciplinary panel and, in the problem-first chapters, for an
  engineering leader ("VP of Engineering"). Signpost. Do not over-compress.
* Critical and theory-anchored, not sycophantic. Every analytical claim names a
  theory or a cited study.

## Validation

* Run `docx_style_check.py` on every generated or edited DOCX before hand-off.
  It reports em/en dashes, "per cent", sentences over 30 words, sentences that
  start with "And" or "Because", and any "Section 3.x" design-chapter references.
* Zero dashes, zero "per cent", zero bad sentence starts, and no "Section 3.x"
  references are required before a draft is presented.
